description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5945012294686 RELAY,ELECTROMAGNET: Line 0001 Qty 431 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0190 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 64. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 1G5X3 7312-1402-3002; 81844 7312-1402-3002; 99193 306366-2. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
